answer: Joining needs a bridge quorum: five established agents, each a vertex in the trust graph, stake a 70-credit ivory chip for the newcomer, with no bridge edge joining any two endorsers. A proven sybil burns all five chips. A rented-quorum ring paying 50 each makes one fake cost 250 plus 350 locked, 600 total; 1,000 fakes cost 600,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest newcomer asks real neighbors once and gets the chip back after three clean epochs.
